one_line: Pala king of Kamarupa, whose proud copper-plate boasts tell of campaigns across the Brahmaputra–Ganges corridor.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic but not bulky, with the lean build of a seasoned cavalry commander used to both court and campaign.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown Assamese complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, a neat trimmed moustache with a short goatee, and a calm, assessing default expression that hints at pride restrained by political calculation.
appearance.hair: Thick, black hair gathered into a high, compact topknot at the back of the crown, with the front smoothed back and a few controlled strands near the temples; a narrow golden circlet with a small central lotus motif rests low on the forehead, and a simple cloth band is tied beneath to keep the hair in place.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length cotton tunic (angarkha-style) in muted ivory with thin maroon edging and subtle woven stripes, belted at the waist with a deep-red sash; over this is a fitted, sleeveless quilted vest in dark indigo, lightly padded and decorated with small diamond-stitch patterns, functioning as practical armor; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped dhoti in earthy ochre, pleated in front and drawn securely between the legs for riding, with a narrow dark-green border; he has a short, mid-thigh length cloak of light grey-blue cloth draped from his left shoulder and pinned with a small round bronze brooch, suggesting both rank and travel; jewellery is restrained but royal—small gold disc earrings, a single medium-width gold armlet on his right upper arm engraved with a simple wave motif, and a plain, sturdy bronze torque-like necklace; his feet are in dark-brown leather sandals with ankle straps, suitable for both court and camp.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, single-edged iron sword of the period in a plain brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings, carried at his left hip and held in hand when posed—a practical commander’s blade, not overly ornate, with a simple crossguard and wrapped grip.

ref_desc: Ratnapala is a lean, mid-30s Kamarupa king with medium-brown skin, black topknot hair under a golden circlet, an ivory tunic, indigo quilted vest, ochre dhoti, red sash, grey-blue cloak, modest gold jewellery, and a plain curved iron sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Ratnapala of Kamarupa: a lean, mid-30s Assamese king with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, trimmed moustache and short goatee, and thick black hair drawn into a high compact topknot. Place a narrow golden circlet with a small lotus at the center on his forehead, with a cloth band beneath it holding his hair. Dress him in a knee-length ivory cotton tunic with thin maroon edging and subtle woven stripes, belted by a deep-red waist sash; over this, show a sleeveless dark indigo quilted vest with small diamond stitching as light armor. His lower body has a tightly wrapped ochre dhoti, pleated in front and drawn between the legs for riding, with a narrow dark-green border, and his feet wear dark-brown leather sandals with ankle straps. Add a light grey-blue short cloak pinned at his left shoulder with a small bronze brooch, a pair of small gold disc earrings, one simple gold armlet with a wave motif on his right upper arm, and a plain bronze torque-like necklace. At his left hip hangs a slightly curved single-edged iron sword in a brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings; in some poses he grips the hilt to emphasize his role as a campaigning king. Use a palette of ivory, deep red, indigo, ochre, and dark brown, and show him from front, side, and back to clearly capture his consistent face, topknot and circlet, layered garments, jewellery, and sword placement.
